text_block_list.text:
One morning, a month before the Arima Kinen.
While checking my emails, I found the midterm fan voting results sent from the Academy.

A year later, challenging the grand year-end stage once more.
First, I confirmed Grass Wonder's name, and as my eyes scanned the lineup of rivals—
One familiar name caught my eye.
...Have they seen this news already?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the meal~.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: All cleaned up! Stuffed! Completely satisfied, yeeees!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...In the end, Spe-chan never came, did she?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Go ahead and eat without me!"
And that was the last we heard from her.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
“Still...
Grass, you've noticed it too, haven't you?”

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan lately...
...the look in her eyes has changed.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...I will likely be running
against Spe-chan in the Arima."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: When that happens—oh?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Did you get a message
from your Trainer, desu?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan called me over.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: What in the world!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, and what a passionate message it is.
...I can't wait to head up to the rooftop.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm-mm... I see, desu.
So now you're all crazy about Spe-chan, desu?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Are you jealous?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Que!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait, wait!!
Why did it turn out like this, DESU!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan. ...Sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grass-chan...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for calling you out so suddenly.
Thank you for coming.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Have you seen the interim results for the Arima Kinen yet?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...So Spe-chan is running in the Arima Kinen as well, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I will—I will beat Grass-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I watched the Mainichi Okan, you know.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san, Grass-chan, El-chan...
They're all so amazing.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She's squeezing out everything she has, to a frightening degree...
So strong, so dazzling...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —It felt so far away.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: The person I look up to, and my friends too.Everyone is competing in earnest in the very same place.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And yet, I was the only one!!
I was the only one left far behind!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I absolutely refuse to let it stay like this.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I want to clash with everything I've got, too!!
Clash, and compete on the very same stage—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I want to win...!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm going to take the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm the Umamusume my moms are proud of...
Japan's number one, Special Week!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I shall take you on with everything I have.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...And that's pretty much what happened~
choice_data_list: That makes me tighten my focus even more.
That really braces my resolve even more.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan has been training exceptionally hard.
A month from now, she'll surely look like a whole new runner.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"However—'Never Retreat.'
I will hone myself as well and surely fulfill my ambition."
choice_data_list: Grass just keeps moving forward, huh?
Grass just keeps moving forward, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let's see—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san, Sei-chan,
El, Suzuka-senpai, and Spe-chan...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is truly strong,
making it a difficult wall to overcome.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
However... every time I overcome
them one by one...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Every time that happens, I can reaffirm the path I've walked and gain the strength to take another step forward.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I find myself thinking that as well.
Looking at Grass Wonder's bright, beaming smile, words I once heard from Maruzensky suddenly came back to mind.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Still, you know... Grass-chan will be fine.
...She'll be fine."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Because that girl is—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"You've had soooo many of the things
I could never reach, no matter how much I yearned for them,
right from the very start!"

“Because Maruzensky reigned as a ‘Monster,’
she had no equal by her side.”

“Still, there are many around Grass Wonder...
who will help propel her forward.”

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now then... Trainer,
let us have our meeting.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Because I still need to keep training myself!

At the Arima Kinen, Grass Wonder will undoubtedly
take another massive step forward.
—I was absolutely certain of it!
